node.statement: PART VII — PGM INTERPRETATION AND APPLICATIONS. Proposition A.1: Mix(GPS) implements the pretty good measurement over the rank-r Hilbert-Schmidt measure. Corollary A.1: Mix+(GPS) implements a conditional PGM. Applications: (i) limited-entanglement tomography, (ii) shadow tomography with optimal sample complexity, (iii) quantum metrology via locally unbiased estimators.
